segments.comment: B82 C-first source-supported alternative to the retained unpolymorphed corrected11 route, which diverges at allmain.c:moveloop_core lycanthropy chance. Enter a non-were dwarf form before the wererat tin; Upolyd suppresses that separate elapsed-turn gate while cpostfx can assign u.ulycn. This route drops the actual carried club, sling, flint, and rocks one at a time, wishes/consumes the human-wererat tin, creates a hostile newt, shifts to wererat, dismisses the form notice, and attacks north toward the adjacent target. The first C attempt run-oqCzCf missed the tin Eat-it prompt because the magically opened tin needs one pager dismissal followed by y; that setup miss remains in the sibling recipe. This corrected input is C-first and stays outside recordings unless its complete C trace reaches the source-confirmed bite and strict JS replay matches. Retained C direction miss from run-oAfeIO: after polymorph, the visible newt had moved northwest during setup; the northward k inputs walked past it and a later newt attack is not helper coverage.
